{{Quote|And where was security? I saw officers all around undercover, but when they were needed, they were strangely absent.''"<br />"''Perhaps fewer of them should be undercover. Some should be more visible.''"<br />"''The Eucerons hate the security forces. That's why they're undercover. But still, with so many visitors, keeping the peace is the first order of business.|[[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>}}
The '''Eucerons''' were a species native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. They were tall [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with large, domed heads and delicate limbs.

The Eucerons dressed in neutral colors, as if to offset the colorful building structures that filled their cities. Their government, the [[Ruling Power]], hosted the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] on their world in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]].
